narrative.overview:
The category standard of a premium aesthetic clinic, executed at full craft. A warm white ground, near-black ink, and one dusty pink that belongs to the brand's own cabins and light. Nothing performs: no atmosphere, no effects, no decoration that a real clinic would not have on its walls. Confidence comes from real photographs of Cire's cabins and specialists, exact prices set in tabular figures, and generous, even spacing.

Density is calm and editorial: one idea per section, a solid headline, one line of support, then the content (a price list, a definition list, three photos, three reviews). The single action everywhere is WhatsApp, and it always looks the same: a solid ink rectangle with soft corners. Everything secondary is an underlined text link.

This system replaces an earlier look (blush gradients, Bodoni display, liquid glass, drifting light, sheens and pulsing rings). That look is rejected as a whole.
keyCharacteristics: Warm white paper, near-black ink, one dusty pink scale; no other hue.
One sans family (Hanken Grotesk) carrying every role through weight and size.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines and tinted bands, not shadows.
Small radii on controls (8px), medium on cards and photos (16px); no pill buttons.
Real Cire frames only, one color grade, 3:4 crops.
Content is visible by default; motion is short and functional.

rules.name: The Two Hue Rule
rules.body: Only the brand's two hues: the pink family (bands, the featured field) and orchid purple (promotions band, alternating tiles, morado-700 for checks, labels and icons). Both from Cire's flyers and the owner's favorites; saturated fuchsia and turquoise stay in the ads.
rules.section: Only the brand's two hues: the pink family (bands, the featured field) and orchid purple (promotions band, alternating tiles, morado-700 for checks, labels and icons). Both from Cire's flyers and the owner's favorites; saturated fuchsia and turquoise stay in the ads.

rules.name: The Featured Field Rule
rules.body: blush-100 as a card fill is reserved for the single primary offer in a block. Every other card is white with a hairline ring. Two pink cards side by side means neither is featured. The closing offer field is the same color at page scale: one per page, and it holds the standard ink button.

rules.name: The Flat Pink Rule
rules.body: Blush is always a flat fill. No gradients, no gradient text, no tinted glows.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: Every price is set with tabular figures and right-aligned in lists. A missing price reads "Precio por WhatsApp"; never invent a number.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: A section starts with its headline. No eyebrow, overline, uppercase tag or numbered label above it.

rules.name: The Even Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Every content section uses the same vertical padding. Change of section is signalled by the blush-50 band, not by bigger gaps.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element floats over content (fixed button, dropdown, drawer). Cards in the page flow never carry one.

rules.name: The Solid Nav Rule
rules.body: The sticky nav is paper at 95% with a light backdrop blur and a 6% hairline; it is the only blurred surface. No translucent glass panels anywhere else.

rules.name: The No Pill Rule
rules.body: Buttons and tabs are rectangles with an 8px radius. Pill shapes are not used for actions, tags or chips.

rules.name: The Real Frame Rule
rules.body: No stock, no illustration, no AI imagery, and nothing presented as a before/after unless it is a real comparison of a client.

dos: Do use the solid ink button for every WhatsApp action and an underlined text link for everything secondary.
Do reserve blush-100 card fill for the single featured offer in a block; every other card is white with a 6% ring.
Do set prices in tabular figures and fall back to "Precio por WhatsApp" when a price is missing.
Do separate list rows and card regions with 8% black hairlines.
Do alternate sections between paper and blush-50 at the same vertical padding (80px, 112px from sm).
Do use only real Cire frames with the shared grade, cropped 3:4 for photo rows.
Do keep all content visible; no scroll-triggered entrances.
donts: Don't use gradient text or blush gradients of any kind.
Don't use glass panels, frosted cards, blobs, drifting glows, particles or sheens.
Don't put an eyebrow, kicker or uppercase tag above a headline.
Don't use pill-shaped buttons, tags or chips.
Don't add pulse rings, ping animations or hover scaling to buttons.
Don't add a second accent hue or a second type family.
Don't give in-flow cards a shadow.
